verdict.rationale: Dialpad's pricing page says AI CSAT scores 100% of calls so teams can measure satisfaction and learn how to improve it, which is an in-product AI insight drawn from the customer's own call data. The API docs also refer to per-call 'AI data' stored alongside transcripts. However, the evidence is a single marketing line and covers only one insight type, with suggestions merely implied. Missing for 10: documentation of broader AI insights such as summaries, trends or recommendations; explicit evidence of actionable AI suggestions; independent or hands-on corroboration.
